appearance.extreme: A thick tail hangs to the back of their knees, cut through the seat of trousers that have been altered for it.
appearance.obvious: There is a short tail at the base of their spine, pushing their coat out of shape.
appearance.subtle: They are sitting oddly, forward on the chair.

description: A short tail at the base of your spine. It does almost nothing, and it does not fit in trousers.
drawbacks: Ordinary trousers do not work any more
name: Vestigial Tail
